name: ClipUGC
description: Generate AI UGC videos for your app from Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client: create an AI influencer, make her photo, turn it into a talking 5 or 10 second video, add your app screen recording and a hook line, download the file. Needs a ClipUGC API key.
author: ClipUGC

tools.name: list_characters
tools.title: List AI characters
tools.description: List ClipUGC AI characters (AI influencers). Same as `clipugc characters list`. scope "mine" (default) lists the authenticated user's own characters, "discover" the public feed, "feed" own characters first then public ones. Returns items with id, display_name, age, gender, is_public, status, plus pagination. Costs no credits.

scope.description: Which list: mine (default), discover, or feed.

tools.name: create_character
tools.title: Create an AI character
tools.description: Create a new AI character from a plain-text description. Same as `clipugc characters create`. The server extracts the appearance DNA and generates the first look automatically (2 credits; confirm with get_credits). Be specific: nationality, age, hair, eyes, face shape, skin, style, and a realism anchor such as "natural skin texture, not airbrushed". Characters are public by default; set private=true to opt out. make_video=true also stages the first clip (extra clip cost). Returns the character with first_look_id. Looks generate in the background. Poll list_images with the same character id every 5 to 10 seconds until each new look has status "completed" (or "failed"), then pass the look id to create_clip. Advanced: pass name (2-120 chars) plus optional age, gender, dna_json instead of description for a structured create.

description.description: Plain-words description of the person, 10-1000 chars (same as --description). Preferred path.

scene.description: Optional scene/pose for the first look, up to 600 chars (same as --scene).

inspiration.description: Optional local file paths of up to 6 inspiration images (same as --inspiration).

private.description: Keep the character private (same as --private). Default: public.

make_video.description: Also stage the character's first video clip (same as --make-video).

motion_prompt.description: Motion prompt for that first clip; requires make_video (same as --motion-prompt).

name.description: [advanced] Full name, 2-120 chars, for the structured path without a description (same as --name).

gender.description: [advanced] Gender, e.g. male, female, other (same as --gender).

dna_json.description: [advanced] Appearance DNA fields as an inline JSON object string or a JSON file path (same as --dna-json).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.title: Generate character looks
tools.description: Generate one or more new looks (reference images) of an existing character. Same as `clipugc images generate`. Every look is generated from the character's base image, so the face stays the same person: only describe the new setting, outfit and light in scene, never the person again. Costs 2 credits per shot (confirm with get_credits). Returns the created image ids. Looks generate in the background. Poll list_images with the same character id every 5 to 10 seconds until each new look has status "completed" (or "failed"), then pass the look id to create_clip.

character.description: Character id, as returned by other tools (numbers are fine as strings).

shots.description: Comma-separated shot types: frontal, three_quarter, profile, back (same as --shots). Default "frontal".

template.description: Template (same as --template). Omit to let the server pick: scene_recreation when scene is set, else model_digitals.

tools.name: list_images
tools.title: List character looks
tools.description: List the looks (reference images) of a character with id, status (pending, processing, completed, failed), scene_prompt and image url when ready. Same as `clipugc images list --character <id>`. Also the poll call for generate_image and create_character. Costs no credits.

character.description: Character id, as returned by other tools (numbers are fine as strings).

tools.name: create_clip
tools.title: Create a video clip from a look
tools.description: Animate a character look (or your own photo) into a short video clip. Same as `clipugc videos create`. Costs 7 credits for 5 seconds or 13 for 10 seconds; adding scene makes it a scene-staged clip (9 at 5s, 15 at 10s). Confirm with get_credits first. Prefer a silent reaction prompt (mouth closed, no talking, an arc in beats, ambient motion): lip-sync from a still image is what makes AI video look fake. Provide exactly one of image or photo. Returns the clip id and status. Generation runs in the background. Poll get_video with {"id": <clip id>, "kind": "clip"} every 5 to 10 seconds until status is "completed" or "failed", then call download_video.

image.description: Id of a generated character look (same as --image).

photo.description: Local path to your own photo, png/jpg/jpeg/webp; uploaded first (same as --photo).

prompt.description: What the character does, max 1500 chars (same as --prompt).

scene.description: Extra scene description, max 600 chars; makes it a scene-staged clip (same as --scene).

tools.name: create_motion_clip
tools.title: Create a motion-control clip
tools.description: Animate a character look (or your own photo) by copying the motion of a driver video. Same as `clipugc videos motion`. Costs 3 credits per second of driver video, rounded up, capped at 30 seconds (confirm with get_credits). The driver must be mp4/mov, at most 50 MB and 30 seconds; it is uploaded first. Provide exactly one of image or photo. Returns the clip id and status. Generation runs in the background. Poll get_video with {"id": <clip id>, "kind": "clip"} every 5 to 10 seconds until status is "completed" or "failed", then call download_video.

image.description: Id of a generated character look (same as --image).

photo.description: Local path to your own photo, png/jpg/jpeg/webp; uploaded first (same as --photo).

driver.description: Local path of the driver video, mp4/mov, max 50 MB and 30s (same as --driver).

prompt.description: What the character does, max 1500 chars (same as --prompt).

keep_sound.description: Keep the driver video's original sound (same as --keep-sound).

tools.name: merge_ad
tools.title: Turn a clip into a finished UGC video
tools.description: Put an app screen recording and a hook text overlay (plus optional background music) into a completed clip to make the finished UGC video for the app. Same as `clipugc videos merge <clipId>`. The clip must have status "completed" (check with get_video). This step is free at the time of writing; the live cost is the "merge" entry of get_credits. Files are uploaded first. Returns merged_video_id: the finished video id, which is a different id space from the clip id. The finished video renders in the background. Poll get_video with {"id": <merged_video_id>, "kind": "finished"} every 5 to 10 seconds until status is "completed" or "failed", then call download_video with kind "finished".

video.description: Clip (character video) id, as returned by other tools (numbers are fine as strings).

app_video.description: Local path of the app screen recording, mp4/mov (same as --app-video).

hook.description: Hook text overlaid on the video, max 150 chars (same as --hook).

music.description: Local path of background music, mp3/wav/m4a (same as --music).

tools.name: get_video
tools.title: Get clip or finished video status
tools.description: Get the current status of a clip (kind "clip", default; same as `clipugc videos status <id>`) or of a finished video (kind "finished"; same as `clipugc finished show <videoId>`). This is the poll tool for create_clip, create_motion_clip and merge_ad. Status is pending, processing, completed or failed. A clip record also carries merge_status and merged_video_id once a finished video was made from it. Costs no credits.

id.description: Clip or finished video id, as returned by other tools (numbers are fine as strings).

kind.description: "clip" (default) for a clip id, "finished" for a finished video id (merged_video_id).

tools.name: download_video
tools.title: Download a clip or finished video
tools.description: Download a completed clip (kind "clip", default; same as `clipugc videos download <id>`) or a completed finished video (kind "finished"; same as `clipugc finished download <videoId>`) to a local mp4 file. Pass an absolute output path; missing parent directories are created. Costs no credits. Fails if the video has not completed yet.

id.description: Clip or finished video id, as returned by other tools (numbers are fine as strings).

kind.description: "clip" (default) for a clip id, "finished" for a finished video id (merged_video_id).

output.description: Destination file path (same as --output). Default: clipugc-video-<id>.mp4 or clipugc-finished-<id>.mp4 in the server's working directory.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.title: Get credit balance and costs
tools.description: Return the authenticated user's credit balance and the live per-action credit costs (image, clip, clip_10s, scene_staged, motion_per_second, merge). Same as `clipugc credits`. Call it before any generation tool so you can tell the user the cost and stop early when the balance is too low. Costs no credits.

tools.name: list_hooks
tools.title: Suggest hook texts
tools.description: Get AI-suggested hook texts (the short attention-grabbing line burned over a UGC video). Same as `clipugc hooks suggest`. Pass context describing the app for tailored hooks. Pick one (max 150 chars) and pass it as hook to merge_ad. Costs no credits.

context.description: Describe the app, e.g. "my app is a habit tracker" (same as --context).

resources.name: pipeline
resources.title: ClipUGC pipeline
resources.description: The order of tool calls for one UGC video, with polling and id rules.

resources.name: pricing
resources.title: ClipUGC credit costs
resources.description: Documented credit cost of each action and the plan that covers it. get_credits has the live table.

prompts.name: make_ugc_video
prompts.title: Make a UGC video for an app
prompts.description: Walks the model through the whole ClipUGC pipeline for one video: pick or create the influencer, make the clip, add the app recording, download.

arguments.name: app
arguments.description: What the app does, in one or two sentences.

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: What she should say or do in the clip. Leave empty to let the model write it.

arguments.name: recording
arguments.description: Local path to the app screen recording to add, if any.

prompts.name: new_ai_influencer
prompts.title: Create a new AI influencer
prompts.description: Creates a private ClipUGC character from a plain description and waits for her first photo.

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: Who she is: age range, style, setting, mood. Plain words.

prompts.name: hook_ideas
prompts.title: Hook line ideas for an app
prompts.description: Asks ClipUGC for hook lines (the first words on screen) for an app, then picks the strongest three.

arguments.name: app
arguments.description: What the app does and who it is for.
